notes: Paper App. D Table 14; its 3DGS row was retrained on the authors' unreleased re-run COLMAP (garden 28.77 vs our baseline 26.89), so compare the gain over baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-30000 (paper: room +0.27, garden -0.07). The density reloads the training images from --data and reads COLMAP images.bin from ~/datasets/mipnerf360/360_v2/<scene>/sparse/0. The propagation kernel needs the GPU exposed as device 0 (bench.py does this). The first job JIT-compiles two extensions (~2.5 min). Expect it to train slower than gsplat.
